name: JetBlue Plus Card

lostBaggage.notes: Basic Barclays cardholder protections may apply. Verify current coverage at time of application — JetBlue Plus does not prominently advertise a large lost baggage benefit.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Travel accident insurance up to $250,000 when purchasing common carrier tickets with the card.

emergencyMedical.notes: No dedicated emergency medical evacuation benefit.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto rental collision damage waiver — secondary coverage. Must decline rental company CDW.

purchaseProtection.notes: Purchase protection may be included. Verify current terms at application.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extended warranty protection for eligible items. Verify terms at application.

pointValue.transferPartners: JetBlue TrueBlue — family pooling available. Transfer partners include Hawaiian Airlines.

annualCredits.name: Anniversary Bonus Points
annualCredits.notes: 5,000 bonus TrueBlue points each card anniversary year.

annualCredits.name: JetBlue Vacations Credit
annualCredits.notes: $100 annual statement credit toward JetBlue Vacations purchases (flight + hotel packages).

freeCheckedBags.notes: First checked bag free for primary cardholder on JetBlue flights. Saves $35 per bag.

priorityBoarding.notes: Expedited security with 'Even More Speed' at select airports for cardholder.

inflightBeverageDiscount.notes: 50% savings on in-flight cocktail purchases on JetBlue flights.

eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Card spending earns TrueBlue points toward Mosaic 1 status (but card itself does not confer Mosaic status).

travelPerks: First checked bag free on JetBlue flights
Even More Speed expedited security at select airports
2x points at restaurants and grocery stores
Redeem points for any seat, any time (no blackout dates)
TrueBlue family pooling — combine points across accounts
bestFor: JetBlue loyalists who want free checked bags and accelerated points earning on JetBlue travel
